notes.title: A skybox change?!
notes.content:
Several games have received a change to their skybox, including digging simulator, forcing perspective, and grand adventure.

This is more of a proof of concept update and more unique skyboxes will be made next week!

notes.title: Digging Game Scenery Addition
notes.content:
Digging Sim. has at least some scenery to view rather than just empty sky now
Working on making it a more interesting game to play, one step at a time!

notes.title: AFK objects
notes.content: Two random objects will be present when it comes to the afk simulator, randomly chosen, more objects to eventually add, but working on other improvements at the moment!

notes.title: Blade Dodging Tweak
notes.content:
Blade speed reduced by half, growth of speed over time remains the same

Should be more playable now!!!!!!!!!

notes.title: Bug fix.
notes.content:
Blade Dodging now can be played.

For some reason unreal engine 5 was upset that I didn't put a delay before the controller's input was set up, even though in every other level, there is no delay, lol.

notes.title: Fixes!
notes.content:
Whilst Blade Dodging has been updated, it has encountered another bug, this will be fixed TODAY.
Hexshots is now properly replayable after winning, with some variation in enemy locations to target each iteration.
Mowing simulator no longer puts you in the air!

notes.title: Mowing Simulator and Hexshots Improvement
notes.content:
Blade dodging is in the midst of being updated, it requires a whole rework of its system for better improvement due to how janky I originally made it.

But mowing simulator environment has been improved!
Hexshots now has a very familiar style of showing hints where the enemy objectives are, and successfully clearing one gives you more time to find the next, it also has some basic graphics improvements.

notes.title: Grand Adventure and some extra little changes
notes.content:
No longer jumping over a blue void, should help with vertigo issues! The pathway has also been adjusted massively to not be an upwards spiral too, if there's any issues, let me know!

In the 3d minigames, if needed, you can hit ESC at any time to instantly go to the menu

In the 3d minigames, you'll zoom in as a neat little initial effect... a prelude to cutscenes, eventually, as those'll take a bit longer to do for all that need them.

notes.title: Trashcan Game Visual and Interactivity Upgrade
notes.content:
Dinosaur Papers received a full background scenery upgrade!
The tower defense game received a scenery upgrade, and the tower build/upgrade panels will be in a static position rather than anywhere else so they don't accidentally go offscreen.
Ocean Hunter is in major WORK IN PROGRESS at the moment

notes.title: Necessary needed super good update!
notes.content:
Game improvements will be done over the week!
This is a necessary update to give credit where all the recent sound assets are from!
Also, yes, the music mutes automatically on loadup... gotta fix that....

notes.title: Trashcan Games HUGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Tons of music and sounds have been added to just about every single game!
Lots of different clicks and failure noises and success noises and you name it!
Lots of effects added to the tower defense game!
Saps and towers game is... not having a working explosion yet, chaos physics said no!
Stealthers game has a TON of clutter added to make it feel less empty!
Soundtracks added for just about everything, oh, I said that already...

notes.title: An update out of the blue...
notes.content:
It's been awhile and I was tackling steam api problems, attempting to make steam achievements work. Unfortunately, for the time being, steam achievements DO NOT work whatsoever.

Either missing something or there were some changes done that require new things in the past few years, or, just unlucky.

Anyway, updates to the real game can begin again.

notes.title: Reverting
notes.content: Test didn't work and made game unplayable

notes.title: Testing Update 2
notes.content: The tower defense game has been upgraded in this version, but also, one more attempt to fix achievements... here goes!

notes.title: Achievement Test Fix
notes.content: If achievements work after this update then I will be sure to let you know!

notes.title: Nevermind
notes.content: The achievement update is not properly functioning, have to find out if its an error with communicating to steam servers or something else, troubleshooting will take a bit

notes.title: Achievement Enjoying Time
notes.content:
Achievements that are viewed ingame instead now show you how to gain them.

Steam achievements should now be fully achievable.

Cat Maintenance has its sensing areas adjusted to hopefully detect brushing easier, may need another adjustment, but it is able to be completed

Other improvements still in the works!

notes.title: Achievements!?
notes.content:
If you look to the side, you might see that there are now actual achievements that you can get! Awesome! They can't be achieved YET, that's requiring the game update that's coming up for you to actually receive them.

Hang in there!

notes.title: Progress Bars and Tribbling
notes.content:
Achievements now show which game they belong to, most achievements' progress bars will start to fill if they are idling games, for example.

The cat maintenance game has cat purring noises once you hold m1 for a few seconds, very immersive!

Next improvements will be about adding details to the simplistic games' backgrounds like Tree Chopper, for example

notes.title: Partial Updaterino
notes.content:
Lots of background work with the baking simulator's system, it and the achievement rework is eating a lot of time but don't worry very much about it :)

It should now start saving and tracking information between game sessions.....

notes.title: Update Delay
notes.content:
This week's update is being delayed to be launched with next week in order to make sure the baking simulator system works and all those fancy functions in the background are also working.

Achievement screen needs a little reworking so you have a hint of what to do :)

notes.title: Ingame Achievements!
notes.content:
A new menu button has been added, it will let you see there are now a total of 30 unique hidden achievements spread across all of the current minigames.

They are hidden until you unlock them!

Cosmetics and making it look nicer are a work in progress!
Also, the menu boop noise has been lowered in volume.

notes.title: Endless Mode
notes.content: The second level of the tower defense game can now go indefinitely, with enemy health scaling by 1 per minute, working on a debuff/aura tower concept

notes.title: Woops
notes.content: Okay now you should be able to actually see the waves!

notes.title: Tribble Archive Super Upgrade
notes.content: The Archive is now using a pleasant background of ocean waves at night in constant motion, and there has been an addition of 75 minutes of Tribbling for your Cat Worshipping needs!

notes.title: Blade Dodging Update
notes.content: You are now a balloon! The blades have some colors to them now, too, and the white platform was removed to be less distracting.

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements 1
notes.content:
Ocean Hunter's explosion images now properly disappear
Ocean Hunter received adjustments to visual on instruction/description

Forcing Perspective now lets you adjust the trajectory up/down using the scroll wheel
Doesn't reset you mysteriously, completes properly

Fireball Enjoyers doesn't let party members die if you abstain from fireballing at the correct times
Aim Trainer received better visuals

notes.title: Final Update before Full Release
notes.content:
A lot of major changes have been made, such as solving the issue of blooming elements in the lights across levels. Less of an eyesore now.

Stealth Game and Tricks and Builders received proper textures

Small Word Big Feel adjusted to be an instructional 'game'

A few typos fixed

Go Blocker instructions are more legible

Updated store page!

notes.title: Road to full Release 2
notes.content:
Perspective game received a 2nd level!
Ocean Hunter now has explosion icons after you destroy a ship.
Breathing simulator now has breathing noises that cancel when you hover over either button properly, so it does not overlap.

Fireball Enjoyers Anonymous has many more images, remade too.

notes.title: Sound Fix
notes.content: Raised the pitch of 2 explosion sounds in Destroy Em All

notes.title: Overlapping Noise Fix
notes.content: Destroy Em All was having a lot of overlapping noise issues, resolving that!

notes.title: Road to Full Release Part 1
notes.content:
Lots of changes have been made in the first major update before early access is over!

[olist]
[*]Sibling Rivalry has had its button changed, the meter automatically dwindles after starting.
[*]Caveman properly displays the first image correctly.
[*]Dinosaur Papers has sounds added to make it more entertaining to play.
[*]Forcing Perspective will soon have its next level next update.
[*]Mowing Simulator now has real grass!
[*]Go Blocker can actually be played properly.
[*]Tree Chopper sensing has been improved to compensate for wacky ue5 stuff.
[*]Tricks and Builders, the TD game, now lets you upgrade towers a total of 3 times.
[*]Saps and Towers no longer teleports you away after initiating a building removal, explosion fx next update.
[*]Counting Cogs UI adjusted
[*]Hexshots has large sections removed to eliminate areas to guess with.
[*]Fireball Enjoyers Anonymous now has proper images.
[/olist]

notes.title: Fix
notes.content:
Yep, the afk object didn't disappear in tribble simulator
Now it does and will return when the menu is opened just in case

notes.title: Update 21
notes.content:
Added instructional text to Dinosaur Papers
Destroy Em All got attack sounds and looks closer to a sandbox now
AFK simulator is no longer a painting but a simple object that rotates now
(Quick fix on checking if it disappears in tribble simulator and, uh, works)

notes.title: Update 20
notes.content:
Hexshots got an update, now you have a hint on the location of each target, changes after getting the target
Remember you have unlimited time to make each decision, damage to your base only happens after you click!

Ethereal tribble noise exploded from reality in the main menu, should be totally silent after you stop the tribble listening game

notes.title: Update 19
notes.content:
Implemented save file that can be upgraded to store a lot of other information in later patches.

Dinosaur Papers got a lot more added into it, difficulty increase, maneuverability improvement

M to mute or unmute music will be saved

notes.title: Woops, Rollback
notes.content:
Rolled back update temporarily until music issue is resolved
Next update will save the information of the music being muted and Dinosaur Papers being updated
Due to rollback, changes on cat maintenance are temporarily undone

notes.title: Update 18
notes.content:
Readjusted Cat Maintenance, tasks show text, circle appears over image
Added different scenery for Forcing Perspective
Next week will have more added to make it 'creepy looking' or something like that
Added keyboard shortcut M

[b]Pressing M will stop the soundtrack in the minigame that you are currently playing.[/b]
if for some reason it doesn't stop the main soundtrack let me know where

notes.title: Update 17
notes.content: Cat Maintenance has random tasks added and instead of a green dot that gets hidden, it's just your normal mouse cursor. Still figuring out how to solve that little issue, don't worry about it!

notes.title: Update 16
notes.content: Made Mower Simulator have a weird looking neighborhood appearance rather than just a grass square, added more rocks that could be easy to miss

notes.title: Update 15
notes.content:
Sunrise game has been given a better scene
Sheep game has more trees
Perspective game no longer lets you run off the ledge
Fixed camera issues with a Mowing and Sapper game, have to use mouse buttons to move the camera now

notes.title: Update 14
notes.content: Sheep idle game has had an environment upgrade, now it looks a lot more cartoony in a way that matches the sheep - lot more colorful and not a bland box.

notes.title: Update 13
notes.content:
Stealth Game rework
Less Claustrophobic map
Much more area to run around in
Keys and Doors to unlock to get the objective before leaving

Proper topdown camera needs to be worked on
Glitched camera moment still requires using mouse buttons to move, unlike other levels that use the exact same camera settings, just like that UFO that kept appearing where it shouldn't have

notes.title: Update 12
notes.content:
Grand Adventure has had a lot more jumping to do, with the difficulty increasing substantially compared to the usual! There are also some swinging obstacles if you look up.

The objectives now act as checkpoints, if you fall off, you will be returned to the most recent green cylinder you ran into.

notes.title: Update 11
notes.content:
Fixed damage application to enemies in tower defense game
AOE properly works
Bullets hit multiple enemies in a line
Added second level
Enemies will change in color depending on how damaged they are

notes.title: Update 10
notes.content:
Added new AOE tower to the Tower Defense game, removed the UFO again from where it shouldn't be.

New level(s) coming next week!

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
Added a neat silvery "water" in the sapper game to make it look weird
Next week's update is going to be larger







Pssst...

notes.content:
Huge terrain upgrade to the Sappers and Towers game, do you like canyons? I like canyons.

That UFO should be gone from the places it doesn't belong in..........

notes.content: The button that brought you back to the main menu from the schedule didn't have any function, fixed now

notes.content:
Added new player model
Added new tower to sabotage game
Added schedule list of updates and basic contents accessible from main

notes.content:
Smaller update, next week will have a whole new player model for the mannequin using levels!
This one fixes a model issue that rotated with the camera when it shouldn't.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Added a neat lawnmower
Fixed camera issue
Made the mannequin a solid gold so it's less boring to look at

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Added a lot more textures to several games
Added a background to the dinosaur papers game so it isn't just a sky, no more vertigo hopefully!
Placeholder moving clouds for hexshots
More on the way next week

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
The tower defense game, or tricks and builders, has gotten a large update to not only the maze but the game's duration and enemy count
More tower types eventually
Perspective game has different platforms

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Adjusted some of the models to the Blade Dodging and Stealth game respectively, Stealth Game is completable now and has a map requiring usage of your flashlight to navigate certain areas to find the objectives.
The baking game has had some text added to a few descriptions.
Lot more next week!

notes.title: Work in Progress, slight delay!
notes.content:
The next update is going to involve a remade Stealth game level to look less like a bunch of untextured objects and ramps and more like an actual building interior, cartoonish, and more replayability along with other adjustments to the other games. 

Don't worry, still working!

notes.title: Planned for Upcoming Update
notes.content: By this thursday, the 13th, the main issues with the Tree Chopping game should be fixed, as well as issues with a few other games on their functions.

notes.content:
Updated to UE 5.4
Changed out music to all levels except the main which has the widget games, for now

notes.title: Devlog #1, Trashcan Games
notes.content:
Game development road map: in progress

Addition of levels and progressing difficulty to multiple games.
Improving graphics and backgrounds to multiple games.
Fixing bugs in GoBlocker, Tree Chopper, and Caveman
Additional sound and tooltips

There's also full music to add, updating the game to UE 5.4
The detailed list is very repetitive, but it should get more detailed as things go on!
